page.layout: One page, a title page. Top to bottom: title in large capitals and italic lines, then the author line, then a woodcut emblem with a curved scroll, then the imprint (place, printer, date). Nothing in the margins.
page.notes: The woodcut emblem shows a tree above three animals (wolves or foxes) with a curved scroll reading CHRISTVS PACIFICATOR NOSTER, ESA. II. The scroll text is transcribed above in the order it reads (left, bottom, right); the Isaiah reference is read from the scan and may be partly obscured. A dark ink blot or stain lies at the right, below the emblem: stain, not text, not transcribed. A handwritten mark "1." appears at the top right and a brown ink stroke beside it: handwriting, not transcribed. Reading of the imprint date: "M.D C.X." as printed, with stops in the same positions; the spacing after the D is uncertain. Normalisation: VVASERVS is given as printed; the u/v rule would make it VVASERUS, and LINGVARVM and TIGVRI would become LINGUARUM and TIGURI. These were kept as printed because the page is a title page and the printer's forms are the ones to preserve, so the rule is not applied here. Flag for review.
